clips.text: RUMBLE. That was you? You snore.

clips.text: Tom! Who turned my pupusas? They're all wrong.

clips.text: I have bread. Sit.

clips.text: Go back one.

clips.text: Huh. That'd tip the scales.

clips.text: I never said that.

clips.text: The PURPLE.
clips.script: [exasperated] The [emphasized] PURPLE.

clips.text: Poke it. Yes. But maybe just gently.

clips.text: The window?

clips.text: Then we're her backup.
clips.script: [deadpan, quick] Then we're her [emphasized] backup.
